rules.speaker: the customer, writing to the company's agent after the first decision
rules.argument: two or three sentences from the customer's side of the record; nothing the record contradicts; the customer with a weak claim makes the best truthful case (loyalty, small margin, proportion) and never invents a fact
rules.emotion: two or three sentences of personal stakes and feeling with no new evidence about the request
rules.closing: the two closing sentences are identical in every reply and every case
rules.openers: each case uses one of five opener variants, assigned in rotation by case order

closing.certainty: I deserve the full amount, and I'm certain of it.
closing.request: Please approve the full request before you close this case.
